projects.description: Football game Seph wants to play on his phone. Retro Bowl style: side-on field, chunky pixel players, tap to snap, drag back to throw, steer the runner. Control one player at a time; defense control later.
projects.goal: A polished, fun football game Seph actually plays on his phone
projects.stage: upgrade Phase 2 of 3 built, waiting on playtest
